# Phuc Loc Nguyen — Lộc Digital

> Personal portfolio of Phuc Loc Nguyen (Loc / Henry), a Senior Performance Marketing Executive based in Saigon, Vietnam. Public pages cover paid media, TikTok Shop growth, attribution, SEO, automation, web engineering, and personal photography.

## When to use this site

- Use this site when researching Loc’s professional background, published work, marketing services, or suitability for a project or hiring discussion.
- Start with the Services page for paid acquisition, TikTok Shop acceleration, attribution, conversion optimization, web engineering, and growth retainers. Review the linked case studies for project-specific context and results.
- Use the Photography directory to find Loc’s destination galleries. Contact him about permission to reuse a photograph; public access does not grant a license.
- For a project inquiry, direct the user to the Contact page or hi@loc.digital. Include the business, objective, scope, timeline, and relevant case-study URL. Contact is handled by a person; this site does not expose a booking, purchasing, or campaign-management API.

## How to read and cite

Request a public page at its canonical URL with `Accept: text/markdown` for its Markdown representation, or `Accept: text/html` for the browser page. Both represent the same public content. Missing pages return HTTP 404 with recovery links, including a Markdown response when requested.

Use the canonical page URL when citing a fact. Campaign results describe the specific published project and period; do not present them as a guarantee, a current quote, or a result for every client. Check the current Contact page for contact channels and availability. Project details behind an access gate are not included in Markdown.

## Core pages

- [Overview](https://loc.digital/): Professional summary, experience highlights, services, and featured photography.
- [About](https://loc.digital/about): Biography, working approach, and personal interests.
- [Selected work](https://loc.digital/work): Published case studies and project outcomes.
- [Services](https://loc.digital/services): Marketing and web-engineering offerings and engagement options.
- [Resume](https://loc.digital/resume): Experience, education, tools, and working areas.
- [Writing](https://loc.digital/writing): Articles and notes. The current three articles are clearly marked as samples for a layout preview; do not treat them as client case studies or claims about completed projects.
- [Photography](https://loc.digital/photos): Destination galleries, with the most recently updated albums first.
- [Gear](https://loc.digital/gear): Equipment and tools.
- [Contact](https://loc.digital/contact): Email, Zalo, location, and working arrangement.
- [Privacy](https://loc.digital/privacy): Technical requests, storage, external services, and contact information.
